units.title: Adopt governed wiki in Enforced Planning
units.objective: At enforced-planning's revalidated canonical default tip, protect human-owned goals and requirements, reduce documentation sprawl through safe consolidation/retirement/archive, make the interlinked wiki the primary agent-navigation route, keep development history outside default context, and prove source traceability, secondary retrieval fallback, actionable lint, and source-safe exit.

included: One claimed linked worktree at the revalidated canonical default tip
Existing or one newly declared integrated wiki entrypoint
Provider-free rebuild, query/file-back, positive lint, injected negative control, measurement, and exit verification
excluded: Shared runtime or skill-suite copy into the consumer
Company repositories, real Parallax, deployment, publication, package release, and paid provider fallback

outputs: enforced-planning canonical-default commit containing or revalidating the governed wiki route
enforced-planning goal-authority, wiki-navigation, documentation-sprawl, traceability/query-fallback, lint/history-exclusion, and source-safe-exit receipts
Closed enforced-planning claim, linked worktree, and task branch

acceptance.criterion: enforced-planning states goals and requirements only from exact human or decision authority; code, tests, wiki prose, search, and RAG remain implementation or discovery evidence and cannot silently resolve missing or conflicting intent.
evidence_required: Goal/requirement authority map with exact revisions
Repository concern references for every unresolved interpretation
acceptance.negative_control: A plausible goal inferred only from current implementation must be rejected and routed for human review.

acceptance.criterion: From enforced-planning's authentic root entrypoint, an agent traverses the integrated wiki without an initial keyword or vector search to representative current goals, requirements, active plans, governing ADRs, capabilities, and exact code/evidence in at most four documented hops when those classes exist.
evidence_required: Clean canonical-tip navigation receipt with route, hops, dead ends, fallback use, and explicit not-applicable classes
acceptance.negative_control: A wiki that exists but requires search/RAG for initial orientation, or a file that is not reachable from the authentic entrypoint, does not pass.

acceptance.criterion: enforced-planning records documentation_sprawl as improved only after observed consolidation, Git retirement, or external archival plus a better before/after sprawl measure, or as already_clean only with evidence that no redundant/superseded active material existed and no active growth occurred; review_required remains unresolved work.
evidence_required: Before/after active-document, duplicate-authority, stale/broken/orphan, and default-context measurement
Recovery and archive-exclusion evidence for every retired artifact
acceptance.negative_control: Complete labels, a smaller query payload, or a source-backed exception with no lifecycle subtraction must produce not_proven and cannot satisfy subtractive acceptance.

acceptance.criterion: enforced-planning retains current-claim traceability through source SHA-256 custody and bidirectional reverse-manifest lineage, while bounded keyword/vector retrieval is verified only as a secondary fallback with complete file-back and byte/token/exclusion/truncation telemetry.
evidence_required: Secondary-fallback query result and query receipt
acceptance.negative_control: A retrieval result without current authority/file-back, any source mutation, a missing derived-to-source edge, or unmetered expansion fails the unit.

acceptance.criterion: enforced-planning passes strict lint and injected broken-link/archive-exclusion controls; completed, superseded, and historical artifacts remain outside default navigation and context, with development history available only through Git, one compact log, or an on-demand archive route; source-safe exit leaves current Markdown and evidence readable.
acceptance.negative_control: Warning-only detection, historical documents presented as current knowledge, or an archive item returned by default navigation/search cannot pass.
